name: Taming the Beast

start.dialog: There's a wild behemoth in the Mire. Ferocious thing. But I see potential. Help me tame it, and I'll teach you mounted combat. Deal?
start.objective: Help Fang subdue and tame the wild behemoth

progress.dialog: There it is! Beautiful beast! Stay back - this is gonna get rough!
progress.objective: Weaken the behemoth without killing it

complete.dialog: We did it! Look at her - she's magnificent! Here - as promised. Mounted combat techniques. And this spear. Use them well.

party_comments.kade: She actually tamed that monster... incredible.
party_comments.ashka: The bond between rider and beast. She understands it.
party_comments.twist: Can I pet the behemoth? Can I?!

hidden_outcome: If you tame the behemoth without harming it severely, Fang names it after you and gives you 'Gungnir' - her ultimate spear
